responsibility: Implements `ASTTypeBuilder`, a type-specific AST cloning/construction visitor used to synthesize fresh Rust type subtrees from existing `AST::Type` nodes. Within the Rust AST support layer it walks concrete type forms such as tuples, type paths, slices, inferred types, and never types, rebuilding nested element and generic-argument structure with `AST::Builder` helpers where needed and producing a newly allocated `Type *`; this makes it a utility for frontend-generated AST rewrites that need to duplicate or translate type syntax independently of the parser.
same_name_distinction: Defines the out-of-line behavior of `ASTTypeBuilder`: the `build` entry point and the concrete `visit` implementations that actually clone supported `AST::Type` forms into fresh nodes. Unlike the paired header, this `.cc` file contains the executable reconstruction logic and includes the implementation-specific handling/TODO coverage for individual type variants.
